notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 asynchronous-delivery slice to the Requirements Lab's clauses 8.15.3 and 8.16.5. In the embedded in-process profile, a time-constrained federate defaults to synchronous receive-order delivery, may enable receive-order callbacks while idle, and returns to time-advance-only receive-order delivery when disabled. Time-stamped delivery, remote transport, MOM reporting, save/restore persistence of deferred callbacks, package evidence, protected review, and conformance remain outside this slice.
